title: Prime factorization
statementMd:
You are given an integer $*n*$. Output its prime factorization.

If $*n* = *a*_{1}^{*b*_{1}}*a*_{2}^{*b*_{2}}$ ... $*a*_{*k*}^{*b*_{*k*}}$, where $*a*_{*k*}$ are prime numbers, the output of your program should look as follows: $*a*_{1}$ $*a*_{1}$ ... $*a*_{1}$ $*a*_{2}$ $*a*_{2}$ ... $*a*_{2}$ ... $*a*_{*k*}$ $*a*_{*k*}$ ... $*a*_{*k*}$, where factors are ordered in non-decreasing order, and each factor $*a*_{*i*}$ is printed $*b*_{*i*}$ times.

## Input

The only line of input contains an integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 250$).

## Output

Output the prime factorization of $*n*$, as described above.
